title: Cut lore's GitHub Release as an executed, refusing step once latest is verified, not a printed checklist item (pair symmetry with quest, OPAG-646)
description: Dispatched by opum-agent under OPAG-646 (pair symmetry), 2026-09-27. Today lore's GitHub Release is a line in scripts/publish-release.sh's printed closing checklist (item 2 at ~line 288: 'Cut a non-draft, non-prerelease GitHub Release for v$VERSION ... gh release create'), carried out by hand. Releases are current through v0.11.0 (gh release list, 2026-09-27: v0.11.0, v0.9.3, v0.9.2), but only because someone remembered; quest's lagged to v0.6.0 unnoticed the same way. quest-cli is making its own executed (QCLI-398, relayed by opum-agent as under review, not read here): promote-release.mjs --promote cuts the GitHub Release from the CHANGELOG section once latest is verified, and refuses before any tag moves if the section is missing. Lore should do the same, in the same place in the flow, with the design paired with quest-cli. Sequencing: under LCLI-621 (the held Article 3.5 amendment, ODOC-302) the point where latest is set becomes the final @opum-ai/lore X publish rather than a dist-tag move, so this lands with or after LCLI-621 rather than being built twice. Overlap: LCLI-618 AC2 lists 'GitHub Release' among the post-latest checklist items; once this lands that item is executed, not printed.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The design is paired with quest-cli: the step location, the CHANGELOG section it reads, the release title and notes shape, and the refusal conditions match QCLI-398 or each difference is named and agreed, recorded on this task with the quest-cli ref read
lore's promote step (promote-latest.mjs, or its LCLI-621 successor) refuses BEFORE moving or publishing anything onto latest when CHANGELOG.md has no ## [X] section for the version being promoted

Once latest is verified for X, the step creates a non-draft, non-prerelease GitHub Release for vX from that CHANGELOG section; it is idempotent (an existing release for vX with the same notes is not duplicated or silently rewritten) and a failure is reported, not swallowed

publish-release.sh (and LCLI-618's post-latest checklist) no longer asks a human to cut the release; tests pin the refusal, the created release's shape via a stubbed gh, and the absence of the printed item
bun test and bun run lore check exit 0; a reviewer pass covers the scripts/ change

plan: 1. PHASE 1 (done in this pass, tracker only): pair the design with quest-cli QCLI-398 read by ref at quest-cli 0f671906e7487b35db9441bfff81b2f7832876fa; record MATCH/DIFFER per point in the DESIGN PAIRING note. No code.

2. PHASE 2 GATE: start only after LCLI-617 (validateRecord in scripts/promote-latest.mjs) lands on origin/dev. Merge origin/dev into feat/LCLI-622-executed-github-release and re-read promote-latest.mjs main(), since every line number in the note moves. Phase 2 exclusive file scope is exactly: scripts/github-release.mjs (new), scripts/promote-latest.mjs, scripts/publish-release.sh (comment only), test/github-release.test.ts (new), test/promote-latest.test.ts, docs/runbooks/release-publishing.md, CHANGELOG.md, .quest/tasks/LCLI-622.json.

3. scripts/github-release.mjs (new), mirroring quest's module and export names: RELEASE_REPOSITORY = github.com/opum-ai/lore-cli (built from pair-receipt.mjs RECEIPT_HOST and OWN_REPOSITORY); changelogSection(changelog, version) matching ^## \[X\](?:\s.*)?$ and ending at the next '## ' line or at the trailing link-reference block ([...]: url) at end of file, trimmed, null when absent or empty; releaseTitle -> 'Lore CLI X' (keeping quest's never-published suffix rule); releaseNotesFor(version, {changelogPath}); ensureGitHubRelease({version, notes, title, latest=true, dryRun=false, execFile}) returning {ok, action, detail}, never throwing. Reads with gh release view vX -R <repo> --json tagName,body,isDraft,isPrerelease; creates with gh release create vX -R <repo> --verify-tag --title --notes-file <tmp> --latest=true|false; existing + same notes -> gh release edit vX -R <repo> --latest; existing + different notes, draft or prerelease -> ok:false, never edited. JSDoc types checked by tsconfig.scripts.json (no .d.mts). Standalone CLI --version X [--create] [--not-latest] whose main RETURNS an exit code (0 ok, 1 refused/failed, 2 usage), no process.exit.

4. scripts/promote-latest.mjs: (a) new pre-move step after step 8 (the X probe) and BEFORE the dry-run return and the record write: releaseNotesFor(version) -> refuse (return 1, 'Nothing has moved') when no non-empty ## [X] section; then ensureGitHubRelease({dryRun:true, execFile: run}) on BOTH --dry-run and --promote -> refuse (return 1) when !ok (gh missing/logged out/offline/unreadable, or an existing vX whose notes differ or that is a draft/prerelease). Dry run prints the planned line. (b) after step 11 (verifyTags + verifyFinalLauncher) and before the README read-back: rm the private npmrc dir and clear npmrcDir (the finally stays as a backstop), then ensureGitHubRelease({execFile: run}) and report the outcome. (c) exit: README read-back not PASSED OR release not cut -> README_READBACK_EXIT (3), widening its documented meaning to 'promotion complete and verified, a post-latest step did not complete; do NOT roll back'; the failure message names the repair command node scripts/github-release.mjs --version X --create. (d) postLatestChecklist item 2 reports the executed outcome (created / already existed, marked latest / NOT CUT + repair command) instead of the printed gh release create instruction. (e) header comment steps 11-12 and exit-code block, and the LCLI-622 comment at postLatestChecklist, updated. --rollback path unchanged: it never reaches a release call.

5. scripts/publish-release.sh: comment-only edit at the closing-checklist block (~lines 262-267) saying the GitHub Release is now cut by promote-latest.mjs, not printed. No behaviour change; test/publish-release-script.test.ts already asserts the staging checklist carries no gh release line and stays unchanged.

6. test/github-release.test.ts (new), quest's cases with a stubbed execFile: extraction (dated bracketed heading, 0.1.1 vs 0.1.10, absent/empty/Unreleased -> null, last section excludes the link-reference block, every ## [X] heading in the real CHANGELOG yields notes), title, create argv (-R pinned, --verify-tag, --latest=true/false, notes file), exists+same notes -> edit --latest only, exists+different notes -> ok:false and no edit/create, draft/prerelease -> ok:false, dry run reads only, failed create/edit returned not thrown, unreadable view refuses, 'release not found' in message only reads as absent. Plus the measured fact that trim(existing v0.11.0 body) equals the section, as a fixture-free comment, not a network test.

7. test/promote-latest.test.ts: the in-memory world gains a gh release view/create/edit responder. Pin by OBSERVED CALL ORDER through main(), not source layout: missing ## [X] refuses with zero npm writes and no record file (AC2), on --dry-run and --promote; unusable gh refuses before any write on both paths; dry run issues only the view; --promote issues create after the last latest write and after verifyFinalLauncher's reads, and after the npmrc dir is gone (assert the dir no longer exists when the stub sees the create); --rollback issues no gh release call; failed create -> exit 3 with 'do NOT roll back' and the repair command, still running the README read-back; checklist no longer contains 'gh release create v' (AC4) and the runbook-item test's step list is updated to the executed wording.

8. docs/runbooks/release-publishing.md section 3 item 8 step 2: executed, not manual; what the refusal means; the repair command; and that --rollback leaves GitHub marking vX latest, with the gh release edit v<prior> --latest remedy (quest's reviewer finding 2). CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] entry.

9. Gates: bun test, bun run typecheck (both tsconfigs), bun run lore check from source; lint. Mutation checks with PREDICTED subsets: drop the escaped brackets from the heading regex -> only the bracketed-heading extraction tests red; move the preflight into the dry-run branch -> only the --promote gh-refusal ordering test red; move the npmrc rm after the cut -> only the cleanup-order test red. Record exact counts.

10. opum-workflow:reviewer pass on the scripts/ change (CLAUDE.md: a gate that is wrong fails only during a release), fix findings, open the PR to dev, check ACs only with evidence. Record honestly that the post-promote cut first runs live at the next lore promotion.
implementationNotes: CHECK BEFORE IMPLEMENTING (opum-agent, cross-session, 2026-09-27): quest-cli's reviewer found two defects in QCLI-398's executed release step, both fixed before merge; reference opum-ai/quest-cli scripts/github-release.mjs and promote-release.mjs on main at 06189deb (commit resolved by API here; github-release.mjs blob 89c24028). (1) A failed release step left the npm token file on disk because process.exit skipped the finally that deletes it -- cut the release AFTER credential cleanup, and never exit from inside the try. (2) --promote did not check gh works before moving tags -- the step must refuse before ANY tag or latest move if gh is unusable, as the dry run does. Both are candidate ACs for this task when it unholds.
